flags.why: The example explains the title instead of showing it in use.
flags.fix: Vị quan lang ấy là con trai vua Hùng. = That prince was a son of a Hùng king.

flags.why: The example defines the photosphere instead of showing the word in use.
flags.fix: Các nhà khoa học đang quan sát quang cầu của Mặt Trời. = Scientists are observing the Sun's photosphere.

flags.why: The example explains what photochemistry studies instead of showing the word in use.
flags.fix: Cô ấy đang học quang hoá học. = She is studying photochemistry.

flags.why: In hóa, the tone mark is on the first vowel, o, rather than the second vowel.
flags.fix: photochemistry (spelling with the tone mark on the first vowel)

flags.why: The example classifies the subject instead of showing the word in use.
flags.fix: Tôi đang đọc một cuốn sách về quang hóa học. = I am reading a book about photochemistry.

flags.why: Quang tử remains in modern scientific use for photon, including in [university teaching materials](https://fas.hcmute.edu.vn/Resources/Docs/SubDomain/fas/Dethi_dapan/HK2_22_23/%C4%90%C3%A1p%20%C3%A1n%20M%C3%B4n%20KT%20ph%C3%A2n%20t%C3%ADch%20v%E1%BA%ADt%20li%E1%BB%87u-062023.pdf), so archaic and the claim that it has been replaced are misleading.
The example explains the terminology instead of using the word to refer to a photon.
flags.fix: Nguyên tử hấp thụ một quang tử. = The atom absorbs a photon.

flags.why: The example defines the field instead of showing the word in use.
flags.fix: Cô ấy muốn theo đuổi ngành quang tử học. = She wants to pursue photonics.

flags.why: Quay trở means to turn or maneuver, whereas returning is expressed by quay trở lại or quay trở về.
The example uses quay trở lại meaning to return, rather than quay trở meaning to turn or maneuver.
flags.fix: Phòng chật quá, khó quay trở. = The room is so cramped that it is hard to turn around.
